decisions.reason: The air quality sensor module fits the firm's modular sensor platform and has its own product page, and a niche maker can carry a new sensor whose sales are still uncertain because it adds little cost to the range.
The voltage measurement module is the current generation replacing version 2.0, so it is the product the firm is moving customers onto rather than one it would retire.
A software proxy is a stopgap that a fuller native MQTT integration could replace, so a moderate drop risk exists, but it costs little to maintain and is likely kept for at least another year.
The CAN bus interface serves industrial customers within the existing modular system, and with no shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The carbon dioxide sensor module complements the air quality sensor in a growing environmental monitoring segment and needs little extra resource.
The touch panel accessory has its own page and supports the firm's display and interface lineup, so keeping it is consistent with the firm's habit of maintaining a broad catalogue.
